name: Tick Blood
blurb: Every known world spawn for Tick Blood, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

creature_drops.mechanism: UseAll list with 3 entries. Entry 0: TickBlood at CN=65 (35% chance of 1 tick blood). Entry 1: TickBloodSac at CN=0 (guaranteed 1 tick blood sac). Entry 2: LLE_Creature_Small (generic small creature loot).
creature_drops.note: Every tick kill guarantees 1 tick blood sac. There is a 35% chance of also receiving 1 tick blood from the same kill. All tick variants (Tick, Foul Tick, Wretched Tick, Vile Tick, Glowing Tick) share the same death item list.

resource_generators.note: Morbid Well resource generator produces tick blood at ~14.3% per cycle (1 of 7 items in ATX_Resources_MorbidWell_Blood, pick-one). Mystery Crate (Mire) has a ~3.85% chance per crate (2 of 52 entries in LL_InsectParts, pick-one).
